subject: health
concept: Applying emotional awareness, coping strategies, physical-emotional connection, trusted-adult support, empathy, and screen balance to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student works through a realistic scenario involving a hard feeling, choosing a healthy response
exercise.abstract: Student explains their chosen response, referencing a specific coping strategy or support source from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: response reflects a genuine, healthy strategy from this unit
misconception_flags: response suggests avoiding or suppressing the feeling entirely with no healthy coping strategy

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
